data.title: Deutschlandticket subscription confirmation
data.summary: Musterstadt Verkehrsbetriebe GmbH (MVB) confirms your Deutschlandticket subscription as a mobile ticket, valid from 1 January 2026 at €63.00 per month. It runs indefinitely and can be cancelled monthly.
data.explanation: This confirms your order of the Deutschlandticket (nationwide local public transport pass) as a phone ticket in the "MVB mobil" app. The fee of €63.00 is debited by SEPA direct debit at the start of each month. You can cancel monthly, but the cancellation must reach MVB by the 10th of a month to end the contract at the end of that month. You can cancel online, by e-mail or in writing. If the price changes, MVB will tell you at least six weeks ahead, and you can then cancel when the change takes effect. No action is needed now.
